About

I'm a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) at PharmEasy, one of India's leading digital healthcare companies. I test and automate the APIs behind Pharmacy, Diagnostics and Plus/Pro membership, and own the test strategy for the Offline Doctor Consultation partner integration.

My core is API test automation with Rest Assured (Java), Postman and cURL: 60+ RESTful APIs and microservice integrations validated, 17 automated scenarios in Rest Assured and Playwright, and 45+ defects found in a single major feature before production. I also built a Jenkins-triggered utility that cut order status changes from half a day to 5 minutes.

I started as a backend intern at LG Electronics (Java, Spring Boot, MySQL), which is why I read code and logs while testing, not just the UI.
